digest.component_or_area: MCP server architecture and autodeploy integration
propositions: An ADR must settle MCP-on-box HTTP server exposure, authentication, and certified-op routing by documenting nginx TLS edge with static bearer-token verifier, immutable release autodeploy with blue-green pointer swap, and opcert signing under existing environment ID.

The MCP autodeploy target uses immutable release with atomic nginx upstream flip and retire-when-idle (not stop-and-drain), gated by in_flight gauge counting only long-running certified ops and memory-pressure alarm.
The MCP server signs plan-review and completion-verifier certs under the existing REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID without introducing a new environment or making verify.require_environment multi-valued.
The ADR must name concrete config keys (transport, http_tls_at_edge, auth_resource_server_url, verifier mode) and cross-reference ADR 0049, 0050, 0079, and the local main-tracking updater precedent.
No behavioral code or infrastructure changes are included; only docs/adr/ paths are touched and the acceptance criteria are verified by file inspection and grep.
